summary: Feed s067_single to NDR is degraded due to high encrypted share (92.6% vs 90% tolerance). All other checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, VLAN) are healthy. Payload visibility is limited without decryption.

findings.root_cause: 93% of bytes are TLS-encrypted (likely TLS 1.3) and forwarded without decryption at the packet broker. No SSL visibility/decryption policy is applied before the NDR, so encrypted payload exceeds the NDR's 90% tolerance.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for signature and behavioral detection. With 92.6% encrypted, it is blind to C2, lateral movement and exfiltration inside encrypted flows, significantly reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypting relevant TLS flows at the packet broker restores cleartext payload to the NDR and brings encrypted share below 90% threshold, restoring detection without changing TAP/SPAN or overloading the 10G tool port. Use selective policy for privacy/compliance.
